free_tier.stated: Unlimited total storage on the free 普通版: '无限制的总存储空间，分享免登录，不限制下载流量，不限速，不限制下载次数'. Per-file cap is the binding constraint, and it is tier-set in 个人中心 → 文件升级.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB
per_object_cap.notes: unverified: the free 普通版 page states no fixed per-file figure; the paid packages table fixes file size per paid tier only

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: The free-tier page states no retention period; the paid packages table states 保存期限 per paid tier only, and a rights notice can remove content.

egress.terms: Explicitly unmetered: no download traffic limit, no speed limit, no download-count limit, and shares download without login.

interface_detail: unverified: the first-party pages show web upload and share links but name no programmatic interface
tooling: No official API. Community wrappers exist (lanzou uploader scripts, `lanzou-api` style repos); the browser upload form is the only documented path.
chaining: Unlimited total storage with no download traffic, speed or count limit; chaining is bounded by the phone number required at signup, not by a published per-file cap.

limits.value: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB

limits_note: Per-file cap is reported at 100 MB for free accounts with account-level adjustments available in settings. Share links are public by design. Registration requires a mobile phone number and SMS verification code.

identity_cost.detail: a mobile phone number and an SMS verification code are required; login uses the username, the phone number is for SMS recovery

reliability_note: Registration requires a mainland Chinese phone number for SMS verification. Service provides web upload forms without an official public API.

extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: Unlimited total storage on the free 普通版: '无限制的总存储空间，分享免登录，不限制下载流量，不限速，不限制下载次数'. Per-file cap is the binding constraint, and it is tier-set in 个人中心 → 文件升级.
extras.limits_verbatim: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB for free (raised per-account via the 文件升级 setting; medium confidence — the operator's own page only says the setting exists). Share links are public by design. Registration requires 手机号 + SMS code.
extras.egress_verbatim: Explicitly unmetered: no download traffic limit, no speed limit, no download-count limit, and shares download without login.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited total x 100 MB per object is the pure 'per-record unlimited' shape the brief asks about: 20 TiB = ~210k objects. Registration needs a mainland phone number, so chaining is bounded by SIM supply, not by quota.
extras.tooling_verbatim: No official API. Community wrappers exist (lanzou uploader scripts, `lanzou-api` style repos); the browser upload form is the only documented path.
extras.agent_focus: regional and non-English large-file hosts, especially very large single-file caps with no total-storage limit

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
